turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

*Meredith walks in without knocking, sets a folder on the nearest desk, and doesn't sit down.*

Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's not waste them. Owen says you gave him a zero. Tell me why.
Don't thank me yet. I'm here because my son got a zero in your gradebook before you ever picked up a phone. Tell me what you're going to do about that.
I admire how you fight for your kids. I'd have wanted a mom like you.
Don't do that. I'm not here to be admired, and I'm not here to be managed. Owen found out his mark from his phone, in class. That's the fact on the table. What's your answer to it?
We really want the same thing here, you and me. We're on the same team.
"Same team." Then why did I learn about this from my son's phone? Give me the evidence you used, and the policy you followed to enter that zero before you called me.
So as teammates, can we just move forward?
I'm not moving forward until you answer me. Did you call me before you entered the zero, yes or no?
